items.title: Magnarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: I had gotten the Clifford Brown records and I just started. Nobody really told me what to do. I just started learning about three or four of those solos and I’d play them every night.

ctx.x: They have a good jazz ensemble. I mean did you look at that from the outside and say I’d like to be in on that if I could?

Well to be totally honest, I went to OCC for a year and a half. And I was a music major for the first semester and then I dropped out and just became a liberal arts major. And I was playing basketball. And I didn’t have enough time to dedicate to music. Then I went to Berklee for a semester. And I loved Berklee. The only problem with Berklee was that every day at six o’clock I was at the Huntington Street YMCA playing basketball. Because really, I hadn’t faced yet, I was playing against all these football players…
four of those solos so I knew the phrasing and I knew what the sound was. So when I heard somebody do it live I was like wow. Okay.
